subject: The 3-minute routine that saved 800+ users
preview_text: Most people scan once and forget. Here's the habit that makes this app 10x more effective.
body_paragraphs: You know that feeling when you screenshot a conversation, get the analysis, and feel a rush of clarity? That's the easy part. The hard part is what comes next — the pattern you miss because you only check in once a month.

Here's what 800+ users discovered: the app is 10x more effective when you spend just 3 minutes a day, same time, same place. Sunday night before bed. Wednesday morning with coffee. Pick one slot, scan one conversation, and let the dashboard track the trends. That's it.

The Relationship Health Dashboard is built for this. It doesn't just show you one red flag — it shows you if love bombing is becoming a pattern, if gaslighting is escalating, or if that 'gut feeling' was right all along. Three minutes a day turns scattered scans into a story you can actually act on.

Open Red Flag Scanner AI now. Set your 3-minute slot for tonight. And if you miss a day, don't stress — just pick it back up tomorrow. The habit is forgiving, but the data adds up fast. P.S. Most people who do this for 2 weeks report feeling 'lighter' — like they finally trust their own judgment.
